title: PlumePdf Phase 3 extraction ground-truth fixture
description: Schema for every other *.json file in this directory (MANIFEST.json excluded). Hand-authored during ground-truth authoring: each file pairs one PDF (real corpus file or a self-authored, hand-rolled-bytes generator, never PlumePdf's own writer, so the oracle is independent of the code under test) with expected per-page text. Loaded and structurally validated (independent of PlumePdf) by GroundTruthSchemaTests in ../ExtractionCorpusTests.cs; the full extraction-assertion gate (comparing actual PdfPage.ExtractText() output against these values) is added once page.ExtractText() ships — see the 'STATUS' note at the top of ExtractionCorpusTests.cs.

id.description: Stable identifier, kebab-case, matches the JSON file's basename without extension.

category.description: One of the curated scenario buckets. Not exclusive in reality (e.g. basicapi.pdf is both truetype-embedded and header-footer) — this field names the PRIMARY scenario this fixture was chosen for; other incidental coverage is called out in 'description'.

description.description: Human-readable note on what this fixture exercises and why it was picked.

corpus.description: Directory name under corpora/ as produced by scripts/fetch-corpora.sh (e.g. 'pdfjs-subset-0adc2e7c6652').

generatorId.description: Name of the static byte-builder method on the internal GeneratedFixtures class in ExtractionCorpusTests.cs. The generator writes raw PDF bytes directly from ISO 32000-1 grammar (an approach the clean-room policy in AGENTS.md allows), the same hand-rolled-bytes pattern as tests/PlumePdf.CorpusTests/Fixtures/generate_fixtures.py and benchmarks/PlumePdf.Benchmarks/OpenBenchmarks.cs's SampleDocuments — never PlumePdf's own writer, so the ground truth stays independent of the code under test in both directions (reader AND writer).

method.description: How the expected values were derived: an independent third-party tool (never PlumePdf) for corpus files, or direct hand-computation from the known content-stream operators for generated files.

mediaBoxPoints.description: Page 1 MediaBox width/height in points, informational only (sanity check against PdfPage.MediaBox once wired).

extractPermission.description: For encrypted fixtures: whether the /P permission bits grant extraction (bit 5). Null when not applicable (unencrypted).

encryptMetadataFalse.description: Whether /EncryptMetadata false is set in this document's encryption dictionary (ISO 32000-1 7.6.2).

knownFailure.description: When true, the corpus gate asserts the DIAGNOSTIC is recorded (a specific PLUME8xxx code), not the text — the failure itself is the thing under test, made explicit rather than silently skipped.

diagnosticCodePrefix.description: e.g. 'PLUME8' — the exact 4-digit code is filled in once known; the prefix is enough to write a non-vacuous assertion today.

expectedText.description: Normalized expected text for the page: words separated by a single space, lines separated by '\n'. The corpus gate compares against a similarly-normalized actual result (whitespace-collapsed) rather than byte-exact, since exact inter-word spacing is a rendering nuance, not a correctness contract.

readingOrder.description: 'not-asserted' is used only for pages with no meaningful multi-line/multi-block structure (e.g. a single short line) where reading order is trivially satisfied by any correct implementation.

letters.description: Optional: a small selection of letters with expected approximate bounding boxes ('selected letter bboxes with tolerance'). Deliberately sparse and loosely toleranced — the bbox is documented as a v1 approximation (advance width + font-size-derived height, not true glyph-outline metrics), so this checks gross position/order correctness, not sub-pixel glyph metrics.

indexInPage.description: 0-based index of this letter within the page's flattened letter sequence in expected reading order.
